title: Energy-Flow Cosmology: Unified Analysis of BAO, SN Ia, and RSD
abstract: Unified cosmological analysis testing Energy-Flow Cosmology against combined BAO, SN Ia, and RSD observations. The effective gravitational coupling mu(a) is derived from EFC field equations, not phenomenologically fitted. With beta=0.16 and fixed transition hyperparameters, EFC achieves chi2_total=51.1 vs LCDM chi2=49.4 (Delta chi2=+1.7), demonstrating regime consistency without internal tension.

efc_context.epistemic_layer: First regime-consistency check against combined cosmological data

key_results: mu(a) derived from EFC field equations, not phenomenologically fitted
BAO and SN identical to LCDM by construction (gamma=0)
RSD slightly worse (Delta chi2=+1.7) but within statistical fluctuations
Same S(a) describes geometry and growth without tension
EFC total chi2=51.06 vs LCDM chi2=49.35
